# Strings that must never appear in the tree. One regex per line, blank lines and # comments ignored.
# CI greps the whole repo with these; app/tests/test_workflows.py checks the shipped workflow JSON.
# They live here because .github is the one directory the grep skips, so the list itself is not a hit.
10\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+
svc\.cluster\.local
microsoftOutlook
localhost:5679
